name: dsh-visuals
description: Optional, provenance-preserving public image search for DSH Vibeify.

interface.longDescription: Adds an optional local visual-source capability to DSH Vibeify, combining Wikimedia Commons and Openverse with keyed Pexels and Pixabay searches while preserving creator, source and licence provenance.
defaultPrompt: Explain how Vibeify chooses a reusable image.
Help me add Pexels and Pixabay keys safely.
